note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing.

cases.name: git_log
cases.why: the local clone has the same history on both arms, which is where the second commit is counted

cases.name: git_show
cases.why: the second commit touches the same file on both arms

cases.name: get_issue
cases.why: neither arm finds the issue live GitHub holds: both read the one fake, which holds nothing

cases.name: search_issues
cases.why: both arms are refused a search of a repository the fake does not hold, in GitHub's words

mirage.command: gh api search/issues -X GET -f 'q=repo:theonion/fartscroll.js created:2014-09-22' 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.errors[].message'
